facts.business: The company earns commission income by assisting clients in developing their business and is developing its land assets in Goa.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material uncertainty related to going concern as net worth is fully eroded and current liabilities exceed current assets; financial statements prepared on going concern basis based on management's ability to repay obligations through utilization of property, plant and equipment, generating regular incomes and resuming normal operations.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern
Dependence on commission income and land development
Geopolitical tensions and global trade uncertainties
Climate-related risks and commodity price fluctuations
facts.related_party_note: Loans from body corporates (secured and unsecured) as per Notes 14.1 and 14.2; no amount guaranteed by Directors.
